name: sandbox-create-card-required
about: A self-serve account that started its five sandboxes without a card: 402 card_required, with the page that adds a card (checked with a refundable charge) in fix. Its sandboxes' files and exports still work.

response.error: a card is needed to start more sandboxes: you have started 5, and 5 may start without a card. Your first month stays free with a card on file. Running sandboxes, their files and exports are not affected
response.fix: add a card at https://node.example:48000/app/#/billing (it is checked with a $1.00 charge that is refunded at once), then try again
